account.title: My account
account.intro: Manage your login ID, password, personal details, and security settings.
account.loginHint: Your email is your login ID and cannot be changed.
account.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters.
account.securityHint: On mobile you can enroll Face ID / fingerprint. Use OTP if biometrics are unavailable.

onboard.title: Card setup
onboard.lead: We create an on-chain wallet, register you with Wirex, complete KYC, then issue a card.

walletMode.title: Wallet connection
walletMode.lead: Card spend always leaves our Smart Wallet (WUSD/WEUR). A connected wallet is for signing and identity only.
walletMode.spendNote: POS never prompts MetaMask. BTC, Solana, and closed-loop points use the bridge into our rail.
walletMode.embeddedDesc: We issue and store the EOA plus Wirex Smart Wallet.
walletMode.externalDesc: Bind a MetaMask (or other EVM) wallet by signature. Card balance stays on our Smart Wallet.
walletMode.needMetamask: A browser wallet such as MetaMask is required.
walletMode.bridgeDesc: Non-connectable assets are debited on the partner ledger and credited to our Smart Wallet.
walletMode.noneEnabled: No wallet mode is enabled for this merchant. Contact HQ.

cards.title: Cards
cards.createCardDesc: Choose Virtual or Physical card. Assign limit after issuance.
cards.createCardLimitNote: Set limit (Daily or Lifetime) after creation.
cards.limitTypeLifetimeDesc: Use until allocated amount is exhausted
cards.issueVirtualDesc: Instant digital card for online and mobile payments
cards.issuePlasticDesc: Metal-tone physical Visa card for global spend
cards.issueIntro: Choose a virtual or plastic sample card to issue instantly.
cards.manageIntro: Manage top-ups, limits, freeze, and Apple/Google Pay for your cards.
cards.noCardsManage: No cards to manage yet. Issue one first.

wallet.title: Wallet Balance
wallet.depositNote: Add WUSD, WEUR to your card to spend.

admin.partnersDesc: Partners onboard customers on their own sites via Partner API. Members who sign up on ICOCARD /register can also issue and run cards. Both channels are supported.
admin.confirmRegister: Register with the information you entered?
admin.confirmRegisterAgain: Please confirm once more. Proceed with registration?
admin.apiKeySave: Save this value securely. It will not be shown again.
admin.kitSave: Save MID, API Key, Secret, and HMAC now. These are ICOCARD keys, not Wirex.
admin.ourKeysNotWirex: Use ICOCARD keys issued by HQ only. Never use Wirex keys.
admin.deliveryHint: Choose API, sub-solution (HQ keys), or standalone sub-solution (merchant Wirex contract).
admin.deliveryStandaloneHint: The merchant operates with their own Wirex contract keys. ICOCARD does not issue reseller keys.
admin.walletFollowHqHint: Uses the HQ default wallet modes.
admin.walletHqHint: Merchants set to Follow HQ use these modes. Disabled modes are blocked in the member app and Partner API.
admin.isolationHqHint: Wirex sees ICOCARD only. Partners never receive Wirex keys.
admin.confirmRegen: The current API key will be invalidated immediately. Issue a new key?
admin.feePerPartner: Applies only to this partner. Saved rates stay independent of the global defaults.
admin.settingsDesc: Sandbox and Production are separate. Production needs your client_id/secret and chain 8453. Helper API is Sandbox only.
admin.clientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the current secret
admin.feesDesc: These values apply to direct users and to partners without custom rates. Set per-partner fees in Partner API. Fees go to the treasury wallet.
admin.useMock: Use mock mode (simulate instead of live API)
admin.orgDesc: Same as ICOPAY/PG: Headquarters > Regional HQ > Master distributor > Branch > Agency > Sales office > Partner. A unit that onboards a partner earns a share of those fees.
admin.orgHqOnly: Sales organization is HQ-only. It is not included in API or sub-solution. Standalone tenants can add it on request.
admin.salesOrgOptionalHint: Standalone only. Separate from HQ revenue-share org. Not available on API or sub-solution.
admin.feePolicyDesc: Default merchant fees and sales-org split. Per-merchant rates can still be set when registering a partner.
admin.distFeesDesc: Share of collected fees paid to each level on the merchant parent chain. Remainder goes to Headquarters.
admin.merchantRegDesc: Same as PG org registration: company profile, representative ID, and password. The company receives a login account.
admin.orgRegSameAsMerchant: Same basic info and representative ID/password as company registration. Password must be reset on first login.
admin.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
admin.basicHint: The company code is assigned only when you save (2-letter prefix by level + 8-digit sequence) and cannot be changed afterward. The same code appears in the company list. Selecting a level shows the matching fields. Organizations can only move upward (not downward); all children move with them. Setting unused also sets all children unused; a partner can be reactivated individually by changing its parent. Enter the password, confirm with [Save] next to the field, then register with [Save] at the bottom. If you forget the password after registration, reset it in [Company lookup] or [Company info], then sign in with login ID + 1! and change it.
admin.parentSearchHint: Click a row to select it as the parent company
admin.zipSearchHintJp: Search by postal code or place name.
admin.zipSearchFail: Could not open postal code search.
admin.orgLoginIssued: Give the login ID and API key to the company. They must set a new password on first login.
admin.issueStoppedHint: When issuance is stopped, virtual and physical cards cannot be issued.
admin.operatorsHqDesc: HQ console operators. Add HQ admins and reset OTP here.
admin.operatorsPartnerDesc: Partner dashboard operators. They may add staff. Not card customers.
admin.customersDesc: Individuals who use the card. Each customer is a single account. Reset password and OTP here.
admin.membersDirectDesc: Card holders who signed up at ICOCARD /register.
admin.membersPartnerDesc: Card holders created through Partner API.
admin.brandLead: White-label brand. Change name, logos and colors without touching issuer integration.
admin.brandLocalesHint: Choose which languages are active on member/partner UI (per ASP tenant).
admin.brandLogosMemberHint: Set the member login-screen logo and the after-login top logo separately.
admin.brandLogosAdminHint: Set the admin login-screen logo and the after-login sidebar logo separately.
admin.brandLogosOtherHint: Shared assets such as the browser tab icon.
admin.brandLogoMemberLoginHint: Shown on login, register, and OTP screens
admin.brandLogoMemberShellHint: Top mark after member login (falls back to login logo if empty)
admin.brandLogoAdminLoginHint: Shown on the admin login panel
admin.brandLogoAdminShellHint: Top-left sidebar logo after admin login (falls back to login logo if empty)
admin.brandLogosSplitHint: Member and admin login logos and after-login menu logos are configured independently.
admin.brandColorsHint: Set each UI area separately. Choosing a tone applies it immediately. (#RGB / #RRGGBB)
admin.brandHeaderHint: Utility bar background on the top right
admin.brandSidebarHoverHint: Background when the pointer is over a menu item
admin.brandSidebarActiveHint: Parent menu background while expanded (not hover)
admin.brandSidebarTextHint: Left menu and fold button text color
admin.brandFoldBgHint: Default background of the « Fold » control
admin.brandTabbarHint: Menu/tab strip below the top bar
admin.brandTabbarTextHint: Text color for tabs under the top bar
admin.brandTabbarActiveHint: Background of the active tab under the top bar
admin.brandAccentHint: Background of the clicked submenu item (not hover)
admin.brandToneSaveHint: Name up to 3 tones and save the current manual colors. Slots 1–2 are prefilled with Light and Dark.
admin.sandboxIntro: Wirex Sandbox status and smoke test. The same console is used per-tenant when delivering ASP packages.
admin.sandboxSmokeHint: Creates an embedded EOA, deploys Kernel AA, registers the user, opens KYC, mints WUSD, and issues a virtual card. No wallet paste required.
admin.sandboxAsp1: Brand, logo and active languages are swapped per tenant in Brand settings
admin.sandboxAsp2: Wirex keys and webhook URL are separated per deployment
admin.sandboxAsp3: Partner API and fee policy stay modular
admin.sandboxAsp4: Keep all translations; activate languages per tenant
admin.feeTemplatesDesc: Create HQ default and extra policies. Partners without a selection follow HQ. Partner-level edits take priority.
admin.feeDirectHint: Follow HQ uses the pre-made HQ fee policy. Custom lets you enter amounts.
admin.settingsFeeHint: Set the treasury wallet here. Create HQ fee policies under Merchant → Fee policy, then choose Follow HQ or Custom when registering a merchant.
admin.directMemberDesc: Direct members sign up at /register. Partner members are created by merchant API. Direct members can issue and top up cards.
admin.otpPolicyDesc: Require Google OTP for admin, member, and partner logins (Crypto standard).
admin.resetOtpConfirm: Reset Google OTP for {email}?\n(They must re-enroll on next login)
admin.brandLoginHeroHint: Admin login left background and impersonation notice. Separate from member login.
admin.brandMemberLoginHint: Background for member login and register. Separate from admin login.
admin.brandHeroTooBig: Background image is too large. Please upload a smaller file.
admin.brandLoginNoticeToggleHint: When active, title and body can be edited and shown on the login panel. When inactive, the notice is hidden and the logo sits above the email/password fields.
admin.brandLoginNoticeEmptyHint: Leave title/body empty to use the default localized notice.
admin.brandLoginNoticeOff: Inactive — spoofing notice is not shown.

earn.title: Earn
earn.subtitle: Get rewarded at every turn — cashback on card spend and returns on balances, with no FX markup on ICOCARD payments.
earn.saveDesc: Hold stablecoin in your primary wallet.
earn.cardSpendDesc: Virtual or physical Visa, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
earn.walletHoldDesc: Stablecoin in your primary wallet, ready to top up the card.
earn.physicalDesc: Metal-look plastic card when your merchant enables issuance.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: No activity yet. Card payments and webhooks will appear here.
activity.intro: Shows account activities such as card payments, top-ups, and webhooks in time order. Live Wirex feed when connected; local ledger in mock mode.

partner.scamBody: There have been cases of people impersonating headquarters or the platform to request money. We never ask for separate payment-related funds. If you receive a suspicious contact, confirm it with customer support or your contracted sales office.
partner.setPasswordHint: This is your first login. Set the password you will use.
partner.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
partner.staffHint: Partners can add staff to operate the dashboard. This is not a card customer.
partner.staffNoAdd: Only an admin can add users.
partner.apiHint: Call card and wallet APIs from your merchant site using headers.
partner.ourKeysNotWirex: Authenticate with HQ-issued MID / API Key / Secret. Do not use Wirex keys.
partner.manual1: HQ registers the merchant and issues MID, API Key, and Secret.
partner.manual2: HQ creates a partner user under User accounts.
partner.manual3: Review API, fees, and this manual in the portal.
partner.manual4: Issue cards on your site with X-API-Key and X-Partner-User-Id.
partner.manual5: Wallets: embedded, external EOA connect, or bridge. Card spend uses our Smart Wallet only.
partner.manual6: A sub-solution is the member app at /s/{slug}. Keys are issued by HQ, never Wirex.
partner.manual7: Standalone sub-solution uses the merchant Wirex contract for operations only. No reseller keys. Wirex sees that merchant.
partner.standaloneHint: Standalone: operations only. No ICOCARD Partner API keys. Tenant Wirex keys are stored encrypted by HQ.
partner.noReseller: Standalone disables the reseller API. Operate via the member app only.

manual.preparing: Full manual copy will be added after product development is complete. This page is the branded outline only.
manual.hqHint: HQ can open every manual: customer, API, sub-solution, standalone, and HQ operations.
manual.partnerHint: This partner type shows its own operations/API outline plus the shared customer manual.

manual.outCustomer2: Wallet modes and Smart Wallet spend

manual.outApi2: Card and wallet API calls from the merchant site

manual.outSolo2: No reseller kit; Wirex sees this merchant

access.hqHint: Create operators as super admin. Group them (General / Settlement / Issuance) and set menu access per group or ID. Same model for HQ, sub-platform, and standalone.
access.partnerHint: Group operators and set which menus each group or ID can open. History of changes is kept.
